title: Add --verbose and --debug flags to lab-vm
objective: Add --verbose (-v) and --debug (-d) flags to lab-vm for progressive verbosity. --verbose prints extra progress information (SSH commands, qemu args, genisoimage output). --debug prints everything including raw command output, timing, and internal state.

acceptance_criteria.text: lab-vm accepts --verbose (-v) and --debug (-d) flags at any position after the command
Default (no flag): same output as today — status lines for each phase
--verbose: prints extra progress info (SSH commands, qemu virtiofsd output, genisoimage stdout/stderr, port discovery details)
--debug: prints everything from --verbose plus raw command output, timing, and internal variable values
Verbose/debug flags are passed through to sourced library files via VM_VERBOSE/VM_DEBUG env vars
lab-vm accepts -y/--yes flag that auto-accepts all interactive prompts (package install, confirmation summary), matching the LAB_YES=1 env var pattern
-y/--yes sets both VM_YES and LAB_YES env vars for cross-script compatibility
